opening.argument: The presentation directly urges viewers to invest in a OneCoin-related deal, stating, “Obviously This is exactly why you have to invest because you have to buy a one-piece deal.” It then presents recruitment as the route to earnings, saying viewers “can invite as many persons as you wish to be and you will always win money.” The binary structure shown on the Bonus Binaire slide reinforces that model: left and right teams contain leaders and investors, with repeated 10% payments down the hierarchy. The message links purchasing, early placement, and bringing in participants to the prospect of substantial appreciation and income, making it an endorsement and solicitation rather than reporting or criticism.
